about: 56 owner messages and where the GM's router should send each (gm.md routing table). 'routes' lists every right answer: one where only one is right, two where both are genuinely right. Fixed commands (PAUSE, UNDO, STOP, APPROVE...) never reach the router. 'on_screen' is the draft waiting on the owner's screen; 'pasted' the review details the router must read out of a pasted review.
